_meta.description: National Squib principal particulars used by the simulator. Every value carries a source id (see docs/SOURCES.md) and a confidence tag: V verified from primary, S(p) primary document seen only via search excerpt, S secondary, E estimated, N not established.
_meta.classRules: C16: National Squib Class Rules 2025 (RYA / NSOA), supplied by the owner on 3 Nov 2026. Values tagged V are read from it (rule numbers in the notes). The rules give sail dimensions, not areas: the sail areas stay as before (S(p)) with an estimate from the maximum dimensions in their notes, to be settled in the physics calibration (review Package 5).

minBoatMass.note: Minimum weight of the boat, including sails, the mandatory portable equipment and permanently fitted optional items (C.6.1, J.6.1). Up to 30 kg of metal corrector weights (C.6.2), and up to 30 kg more of penalty correctors with NSOA and RYA approval (C.6.3)

mainArea.note: Not stated in the class rules, which give dimensions (G.3.4: leech 6815 mm max; quarter, half, three-quarter and top widths 2320, 1690, 985 and 145 mm max). From those with a luff of about 6.33 m between the mast bands (F.3.6) and a foot of 2.743 m, an ORC-style estimate is about 9.85 m2 (E). Main + jib from the rules is then about 15.5 m2, nearer the 15.8 m2 secondary figure (C6) than 16.5

jibArea.note: Not stated in the class rules (G.4.3: luff 5380, leech 4670, foot 2410 mm max; leech no further out than a straight line). As a triangle from those maxima, about 5.62 m2 (E)

spinnakerArea.note: Not modelled yet. Not stated in the class rules (G.5.3: luff and leech 4900, foot 3420, half width 3200, three-quarter width 1880 mm max); about 13.3 m2 from those (E), consistent with 13.5

mastLength.note: Maximum, measured from the mast datum point, the heel (F.2.3, F.3.6)

boomOuterPoint.note: Maximum outer point distance (C.9.6(a), J.9.6). Used as the mainsail foot length

crewCount.note: The crew shall consist of a minimum of 2 persons (C.2.1, J.2.1); no maximum or weight limit is set

mastUpperPointHeight.note: Maximum (F.3.6); the lower point is at 1160 mm minimum

mastWeightMin.note: Minimum, with centre of gravity at 3400 mm minimum above the heel (F.3.6, F.3.7)

jibLuffMax.note: G.4.3; foot 2.41 m max, leech 4.67 m max

spinnakerLuffMax.note: G.5.3; leech the same, foot 3.42 m max, half width 3.2 m max

forwardFlotation.note: Minimum additional flotation fitted forward of the mast (C.5.1(a)(3))
